hero.title:
Real
stories
matter now.
hero.intro: I go to places most people will never go — and I stay long enough to actually see something. Mountains, jungle, desert at 3am, chaparral before sunrise. I come back with photographs that could not have been made any other way, by anyone else, at any other time.

quote.text: My curiosity was kindled by a desire to engage with nature more deeply, and photography became the medium which allowed me to do so. Today, I continue to create work guided by that same curiosity.

collaborate.heading:
The world still needs
people who will go
and look — and come
back with proof.
collaborate.subtext: At a moment when synthetic imagery is everywhere and field presence is rarer than ever, I offer something that cannot be generated: the real thing. Available for editorial assignments, brand expeditions, and conservation documentation — anywhere the story is worth the journey.

offers.title: Gear that earned it
offers.desc: Not posed near a parking lot. Your equipment documented on a real expedition — in rain, mud, altitude, and weeks from a road. Imagery that proves what the product can actually do, because it did it.

offers.title: Stories worth the wait
offers.desc: Long-form visual essays from the field. Months of tracking before a shutter fires. The kind of images that require deep presence and genuine patience — the opposite of everything that can be generated in seconds.

offers.title: Wonder as argument
offers.desc: Photography that makes people feel what is at stake before it's gone. Documentation of species rarely seen by any camera. Work that builds an emotional case for protection — not just a factual one.
